kraken_param_adjustments.reasoning: Conservative bot is over-deployed (58%) in a BEAR regime; tightening entry and stop to preserve capital.
Win rate at 40.5% indicates low-quality entries; increasing threshold and loosening trail to avoid stop-hunts.
Clustered stop-outs on UNI/USD suggest entry criteria are too loose for current high-VIX environment.

critique_summary: The fleet is suffering from severe cross-bot correlation, specifically in UNI and RENDER, leading to clustered losses. While the Oracle bot correctly pivoted to SGOV for the BEAR regime, the Kraken fleet remains over-exposed (50-60% deployment) despite a VIX above 24. AI conviction scores are inflated relative to historical PnL, necessitating a cap on conviction-based sizing.
